entities.title: The repository's vision, stakeholders and roadmap
entities.summary: The root's .dev has its diagrams, glossary and references, but the explorer's Direction group stays empty until the owner states what the repository is for.
acceptanceCriteria: vision.json, stakeholders.json and roadmap.json in the root's .dev, written from what the owner states, with the owner as origin.

origin.description: The owner asked for a plan to refactor retro-games so that it shows everything the cyberspace explorer can show, and approved its Phase 0.

entities.title: Describe the clean-room skills in .dev
entities.summary: .claude/skills/ holds the owner's process for making a game and the repository's only clean-room tooling, and has no .dev folder.
acceptanceCriteria: A component diagram of the three skills and the web template.
A user journey, Make a new retro game: research, GDD, wireframes, art bible, UI design, build and test, each followed by the owner's approval, from create-retro-game's SKILL.md.
A use case, Clean-room an existing clone, from clean-room-rebuild's SKILL.md.
A capability, Clean-room checks, with an operation per script: overlap.py, wireframe_check.py, make_guard_hashes.py, zx_basic_list.py, zx_assets.py.

origin.description: The owner asked for a plan to refactor retro-games so that it shows everything the cyberspace explorer can show, and approved its Phase 0.

entities.title: Walk the repository in the cyberspace explorer
entities.summary: Check, page by page, that the explorer shows what the plan set out to show, and record what it cannot.
acceptanceCriteria: Opened at cyberspace-explorer.com/?url=…/tree/<branch>, the root opens on a component diagram that drills down to games, a game, its src and its engine, and from each web game to the shared kit.
Each of the nine view kinds and each of the eight knowledge groups appears somewhere in the tree, and the Waiting panel lists the open decisions.
What the explorer cannot show (Markdown such as the actor files and LodeStar's knowledge-driven-development documents) is a limitations record in the root's .dev.
